Rae (CS): quick heads-up — some EU onboarding customers reporting 5xx during embeddings ingest since ~06:40 UTC, tickets coming in.
Ben (CS): how big is the set? any enterprise accounts impacted?
Ivy (Eng): preliminary — ~6% of onboarding traffic in eu-west, tied to rerank post-index step. canary introduced at 06:30 showed memory growth and pod restarts.
Kai (SRE): opened INC-2026-2460, scaling a rollback now.
Rae (CS): need an immediate customer-safe blurb: short, non-technical, ETA, and reassurance about no data loss. Ben pls draft.
Ben (CS): draft: ```Hi — we are investigating intermittent ingestion failures affecting a small number of EU onboarding flows. Our team is rolling back a recent canary and monitoring recovery. No documents will be lost; queued items will continue processing once the service stabilizes. Expect recovery within ~30 minutes. We will follow up with an RCA within 24 hours. Sorry for the inconvenience.```
Ivy (Eng): change "recent canary" -> "canary of the rerank post-processing service" and add that the canary will remain disabled until patching completes.
Ben (CS): updated. Rae — I'll send to impacted list and DM top-7 with a tailored note + one-time credit offer.
Kai (SRE): rollback executed at 06:58 UTC; error rate dropping, monitoring shows recovery in last 4m. AlertBot: INC-2026-2460 status: rollback complete at 06:58 UTC; severity downgraded to partial.
Ivy (Eng): root cause summary for CS: memory leak in rerank worker triggered by a tokenization edge-case; mitigation = rollback + tokenization library patch; next steps = extended canary tests for long-doc workloads.
Rae (CS): perfect. Ben — include that line in the 24h RCA. Also schedule a 14:00 CET office hour for impacted customers.
Ben (CS): will do. attaching quick troubleshooting snippet for support replies: ```If you still see errors: 1) Retry after 10 minutes; 2) Provide request-id when contacting support; 3) If backlog persists after 1 hour, reply and we will prioritize reindexing.```
Rae (CS): closing loop — customers notified, rollback successful, monitoring stable. reopen if anything else surfaces. :white_check_mark:
